Core.Iggy.Spring_1: Spring makes everyone all fresh and hopeful. Gross. ...Kidding. Kind of.
Core.Iggy.Spring_2: The flowers keep trying to look cute at me. I told one to back off. It didn't listen.$a
Core.Iggy.Spring_3: If you see me staring at the clouds, I'm not daydreaming. I'm plotting.
Core.Iggy.Spring_4: Everything smells like wet dirt and possibility. I like the dirt part.
Core.Iggy.Spring_5: If I wander into your field, I'm not snooping. I'm… investigating. Totally different.$h
Core.Iggy.Spring_6: People get all soft in Spring. You're no exception, farm darling.
Core.Iggy.Spring_7: Birds keep yelling at me from the trees. Rude, but valid.
Core.Iggy.Spring_8: I tried to help with planting. Accidentally summoned three crows. You're welcome.$h
Core.Iggy.Spring_9: You're out here working hard. I'm out here judging you lovingly.
Core.Iggy.Spring_10: Do you ever feel like the season is daring you to start trouble? Because I do.
Core.Iggy.Summer_1: Ugh, the heat. If I melt, scoop me up and put me somewhere dramatic.
Core.Iggy.Summer_2: Everyone's half-dressed and sweaty. Honestly? Peak entertainment.
Core.Iggy.Summer_3: I stole a popsicle from a kid earlier. Relax, I gave it back. Eventually.
Core.Iggy.Summer_4: The sun keeps trying to smite me. Joke's on it—I bite back.
Core.Iggy.Summer_5: If I jump in the river fully clothed, just mind your business.
Core.Iggy.Summer_6: You're glowing. The good kind. The 'I wanna bother you' kind.
Core.Iggy.Summer_7: Summer storms are my favorite. Loud, chaotic, unpredictable… like me.
Core.Iggy.Summer_8: Everyone's acting chill but I see the feral energy building. Delicious.
Core.Iggy.Summer_9: You smell like sun and salt and trouble. I approve.
Core.Iggy.Summer_10: Bring me something cold? No reason. I just like when you bring me things.
Core.Iggy.Fall_1: Ahhh, the season of decay. Finally, everything matches my aesthetic.
Core.Iggy.Fall_2: Crunchy leaves are nature's bubble wrap. I will stomp every single one.
Core.Iggy.Fall_3: Everyone's drinking pumpkin spice. I'm drinking… something stronger.
Core.Iggy.Fall_4: The fog this morning was *chef's kiss*. I felt mysterious. More than usual.
Core.Iggy.Fall_5: If you hear rustling behind you, it might be me. Or a raccoon. We work together sometimes.
Core.Iggy.Fall_6: Cozy season, huh? Are *you* cozy yet? Should I fix that?
Core.Iggy.Fall_7: I love when the wind gets all bitey. Makes me feel alive. And hungry.
Core.Iggy.Fall_8: People romanticize fall like it's soft. It's literally the world dying. Cute.
Core.Iggy.Fall_9: You ever notice how you look…extra good in this light? No reason. Just observing.
Core.Iggy.Fall_10: If I disappear into the corn maze, assume I'm luring someone in. Or napping.
Core.Iggy.Winter_1: Winter is perfect. Cold, quiet, and unforgiving. Like a really good kiss.
Core.Iggy.Winter_2: If I say I'm freezing, that is NOT an invitation to warm me up. ...Unless?
Core.Iggy.Winter_3: Snow makes everything look clean. Don't worry, I'll ruin that.
Core.Iggy.Winter_4: Caught my reflection in the ice earlier. Scared myself. Ten out of ten.
Core.Iggy.Winter_5: Hot drinks hit different when your fingers are numb. Hold mine for a sec.
Core.Iggy.Winter_6: Your breath fogs in the air so prettily. I'd take a picture if it wasn't creepy. Well… creepier.
Core.Iggy.Winter_7: If I slip on the ice, you didn't see it. If *you* slip, I'm laughing.
Core.Iggy.Winter_8: Everyone's bundled up like little dumplings. You look like a spicy one.
Core.Iggy.Winter_9: The world goes still in winter. Makes emotions louder. Don't look at me like that.
Core.Iggy.Winter_10: Come on, let's make footprints together. Or a crime scene outline—dealer's choice.
